lines.en: Black gold souls, soon to awaken.

lines.zh: 阴影之中，窃魂者的呢喃。

lines.en: Black gold souls, waiting to be caught.

lines.zh: 黑金砂上，我的脚印会消失。
lines.en: On black-gold sand my footprints vanish behind me.
I drift along, trailing cold air.
Black gold souls, close at hand.

lines.zh: 我鼻子前面，全是你的味道。
lines.en: Right before my nose, nothing but your scent.
Player in sight, ready to strike.
Fixing on the player, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 黑金的尘，吸进我的骨缝。
lines.en: Blackgold dust settles in my bones.

lines.zh: 你散发的光芒太强，我分心了！
lines.en: Your glow is too strong, distracting me.
Don't go, I'm not done yet.

lines.zh: 你身上有我渴望的味道！
lines.en: You have the scent I crave.
Stop hiding, I see through you.

lines.zh: 靠近我，让我感受你的恐惧！
lines.en: Come closer, let me feel your fear.

lines.zh: 你身上的热量太吸引我了！
不要抵抗，这是你的宿命！
lines.en: Don't resist, this is your fate.

lines.zh: 你的灵魂散发着淡淡的光芒！
你逃不掉，我已经在这里等你！
lines.en: You can't escape, I've been waiting for you.

lines.zh: 我的力量足以将你吞噬！
你挡了我的路，必须解决！
lines.en: You're in my way, must be dealt with.

lines.zh: 不要来惹我，你会后悔的！
lines.en: Don't provoke me, you'll regret it.

lines.zh: 擦过我的边，你的血就凉了。
lines.en: Brush my edge and your blood runs cold.

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离太近了！
躲开，否则你会受到攻击！
寻找我的同类，一同狩猎！
找到我的伙伴，共享猎物！
lines.en: Find my partner, share the kill.
Come to me, share my power.
Collaborate with me, share the loot.

lines.zh: 我们一同狩猎，共享成果！
两只窃魂者分食一个灵魂。
lines.en: Two soul stealers split one soul between them.
This shiny bit is mine to keep.

lines.zh: 你的灵魂即将归我所有。

lines.en: Souls belong to the Soul Stealer.

lines.zh: 你挣扎得越厉害，越美味。
lines.en: The more you struggle, the better.
This wisp of soul goes in my bag.

lines.zh: 灵魂的气息在我周围游荡。
lines.en: The scent of souls lingers around me.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的魂，我顺手捡。
lines.en: A soul dropped on the ground; I scoop it up in passing.

lines.zh: 我的触手将吸取你的灵魂。
lines.en: My tentacles will steal your soul.

lines.zh: 黑金世界的土，记住了你。
lines.en: The black-gold world's soil has memorized you.

lines.zh: 一百四十年的饥饿，醒了。
lines.en: A hundred and forty years of hunger, awake.
Your soul will keep me fed a while.
What the black-gold land lacks is souls.
I smell your soul burning hot.
Don't turn around; I'm at your nape.
When you die, the soul is mine.
Souls, I'm going to eat you.
My tentacles are about to touch you.

lines.zh: 这副身子，很快只剩空壳。
lines.en: That frame of yours will soon be an empty shell.
My fingers have two more joints than yours.

lines.zh: 我身上还挂着别人的魂。
lines.en: Other souls still hang on me.
I slide low across the ground to you.
Your soul is tilting toward me.
Count to seven and your soul is gone.

lines.zh: 我的指尖已经伸进你的影子。
lines.en: My fingertips are already in your shadow.

lines.zh: 你举起剑，可剑砍不到魂。
lines.en: Raise your sword; steel can't cut a soul.

lines.zh: 这片黑金地，吃人很久了。
lines.en: This black-gold land has eaten people for ages.

lines.zh: 我慢慢缩短你我的距离。
lines.en: I close the distance between us, slowly.
I can count every beat of your heart.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，只等你的最后一口气。
lines.en: My mouth is open for your last breath.
Your Blackstar soul is mine to take.

lines.zh: 我伸手一抓，你的呼吸短了。
lines.en: I reach out and grab; your breath shortens.

lines.zh: 黑金世界欠我的魂，我来收。
lines.en: The Augite world owes me souls; I collect.

lines.zh: 我抓出你胸口的一点光。
lines.en: I pluck a speck of light from your chest.

lines.zh: 这一下抽走你半边力气！
lines.en: This one drains half your strength!
My nails sink into your soul!

lines.zh: 你的魂被扯出一道口子！
lines.en: A tear opens in your soul!
I bite down on your breath and hold!

lines.zh: 你眼前一白，魂少了一截。
lines.en: Your sight whites out; a piece of soul is gone.
I roll up your warmth and take it!
This claw leaves a black-gold mark!
You hear your own soul screaming.

lines.zh: 饥饿的生物，时刻准备着！
腐烂的躯体，美味的食物！
黑金之魂在砂里翻了个身。
lines.en: A black-gold soul stirs in the sand.

lines.zh: 地表的冷风，把我吹成形。
lines.en: The cold wind off the surface gives me shape.
